name: integration_endpoint_returns_success_with_mocked_agent
description: Integration test: POST /query with a valid payload; mock the agent.process_query to return a deterministic answer and verify HTTP 200 and expected response shape.
input: Use TestClient to POST /query with JSON {'query': 'Tell me about EV types'}. Monkeypatch _agent.process_query to AsyncMock(return_value='Integration result').
output: HTTP 200 with JSON containing {'success': true, 'answer': 'Integration result'}
error_scenarios: endpoint returns non-200 due to other errors
